ownership: U.S. Census Bureau public federal reference publications.
allowed_use: Retain and redistribute public code/title references with edition, source URL, hashes, and authority scope.
Use exact edition/code labels when the source edition is independently established.
prohibited_use: Infer a business source NAICS edition from code membership.
Treat missing SUSB vocabulary as proof that a code is invalid.
Infer concordances, primary industries, operational segments, or complete business coverage.
attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau NAICS United States structure (2017, 2022) and Statistics of U.S. Businesses industry references (1997, 2002, 2007, 2012).
retention: Indefinite public reference release retention unless an approved retention operation applies.
redistribution: Allowed with edition, exact source authority scope, provenance, transformation version, and native source integrity.
personal_data_scope: Native official workbooks retain public document-author metadata that may name Census staff. Normalized classification rows contain no person records.
